runner.note: The fixtures this suite needs are named by OS-002 as conformance/sandbox/loopback-vectors-v1.json and do not exist. packages/schemas/origin-policy-v1.json now states every control and every refusal code they must assert, which is what makes them authorable; authoring them is product-adjacent fixture work and is not done here.

note: The reason authority is the origin policy rather than the API reason registry, because a loopback refusal never crosses the API wire and packages/schemas/reason-codes-v1.json requires every wire-visible code to bind to a declared OpenAPI operation. The five refusals this suite will assert are LOOPBACK_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED for a rebinding-shaped Host, LOOPBACK_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED for a foreign Origin on a state-changing route, LOOPBACK_PREFLIGHT_REFUSED for a preflight, LOOPBACK_TOKEN_EXPIRED past the idle window, and LOOPBACK_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED past the ten-per-minute probe limit. The public-API preflight case — a non-allowlisted origin receiving no Access-Control-* header — belongs here too and resolves against packages/schemas/openapi-v1.yaml#/components/responses/Preflight.
